Cuts consumables cost and waste; potential margin and opex benefits per tool.
Indicates broad applicability; lowers adoption risk with existing flows.
Large opex and ESG benefit may drive customer adoption decisions.
Meets stringent specs; competitive edge vs mainstream solutions.
No periodic DI water chamber clean
Improves uptime and yield; reduces maintenance overhead.
